_note: Launch options Soju sets for a Steam game, once, while Steam is closed (scripts/steam-profiles.py options). Only when the player has none for that game; a player's own options, or removing ours, are kept. Sources in 'why'.

4000.title: Garry's Mod
4000.why: Its built-in Chromium (menus, loading screens) fails on macOS and the game stays on the loading screen or closes; -nochromium is the known fix (AppleGamingWiki, Garry's Mod).
